title: God created (bara) three times in Genesis 1: verses 1:1, 1:21 and 1:27
summary: Heading “In Genesis 1, God bara ברא 3 Times” followed by three verses in English and Hebrew where God creates: Genesis 1:1 (heavens and earth), 1:21 (sea monsters and every living creature) and 1:27 (man in His own image, male and female). The word “created” and its Hebrew ברא are highlighted in gold in each.

text.text: In Genesis 1, God bara ברא 3 Times
1:1 In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
בראשית ברא אלהים את השמים ואת הארץ
1:21 God created the great sea monsters and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind; and God saw that it was good.
ויברא אלהים את־התנינם הגדלים ואת כל־נפש החיה ׀ הרמשת
אשר שרצו המים למינהם ואת כל־עוף כנף למינהו וירא אלהים כי־טוב
1:27 God created man in His own image, in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
אלהים ברא אתו זכר ונקבה ברא אתם
